file:R/nba_stats_lineups.R.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats API lineup and matchup endpoints (leaguedashlineups, leaguelineupviz, leagueplayerondetails, leagueseasonmatchups, matchupsrollup, fantasywidget), returning tidy data frames of five-man lineup and head-to-head matchup statistics.

file:R/nba_stats_pbp.R.name: nba_stats_pbp.R
file:R/nba_stats_pbp.R.summary: Core NBA play-by-play retrieval module exposing nba_playbyplayv3, nba_pbp/nba_pbps (multi-game), and the live cdn.nba.com feeds nba_live_pbp and nba_live_boxscore; assembles enriched per-event play-by-play frames.

file:R/nba_stats_player_dash.R.name: nba_stats_player_dash.R
file:R/nba_stats_player_dash.R.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats player-dashboard family (by clutch, game splits, general splits, last-N games, opponent, shooting splits, team performance, year-over-year) plus the player-tracking dashboards (pt pass/reb/shots/shotdefend), returning split player statistics.

file:R/nba_stats_player.R.name: nba_stats_player.R
file:R/nba_stats_player.R.summary: Largest player-data module: wraps NBA Stats player endpoints including playerindex, career stats, game logs, awards, fantasy profiles, estimated metrics, and the cdn.nba.com player headshot helper; several legacy endpoints are lifecycle-deprecated.

file:R/nba_stats_roster.R.name: nba_stats_roster.R
file:R/nba_stats_roster.R.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats common-info endpoints (commonallplayers, commonplayerinfo, commonplayoffseries, commonteamroster, commonteamyears), providing league player directories, individual bios, playoff series, and team roster tables.

file:R/nba_stats_scoreboard.R.name: nba_stats_scoreboard.R
file:R/nba_stats_scoreboard.R.summary: Provides NBA schedule and scoreboard access (nba_schedule, scoreboard/scoreboardv2/scoreboardv3, todays_scoreboard, winprobabilitypbp, scheduleleaguev2int) drawing on both the cdn.nba.com schedule feed and the stats.nba.com scoreboard endpoints.

file:R/nba_stats_shotchart.R.name: nba_stats_shotchart.R
file:R/nba_stats_shotchart.R.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats shot-chart endpoints (shotchartdetail, shotchartleaguewide, shotchartlineupdetail), returning per-shot location and make/miss data for players, the league, and lineups.

file:R/nba_stats_team_dash.R.name: nba_stats_team_dash.R
file:R/nba_stats_team_dash.R.summary: Team-side counterpart to the player dashboards: wraps the NBA Stats team-dashboard family (clutch, game/general/last-N/opponent/shooting splits, team performance, year-over-year) plus team lineups and player-tracking dashboards.

file:R/nba_stats_team.R.name: nba_stats_team.R
file:R/nba_stats_team.R.summary: Largest team-data module: wraps NBA Stats team endpoints including teams, teamdetails, estimated metrics, game logs, historical leaders, info-common, player on/off details, year-by-year stats, and team-vs-player splits.

file:R/nba_stats_video.R.name: nba_stats_video.R
file:R/nba_stats_video.R.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats video endpoints (videodetails/videodetailsasset, videoevents/videoeventsasset, videostatus), returning play video metadata and asset URLs tied to game events.

file:R/nba_stats.R.name: nba_stats.R
file:R/nba_stats.R.summary: Overview/index module for the NBA Stats API surface, documenting the stats.nba.com endpoint families and serving as the conceptual entry point for the nba_stats_* wrapper modules.

file:R/nbadraft_mock_draft.R.name: nbadraft_mock_draft.R
file:R/nbadraft_mock_draft.R.summary: Scrapes NBADraft.net mock-draft tables via rvest and returns a tidy data frame of projected draft picks for a given draft year.

file:R/nbagl_pbp.R.name: nbagl_pbp.R
file:R/nbagl_pbp.R.summary: Retrieves NBA G-League play-by-play (nbagl_pbp) and live feeds (nbagl_live_pbp, nbagl_live_boxscore) by reusing the NBA Stats play-by-play pipeline against G-League game IDs.

file:R/nbagl_players.R.name: nbagl_players.R
file:R/nbagl_players.R.summary: Retrieves the NBA G-League player index (nbagl_players) via the NBA Stats playerindex endpoint scoped to gleague.nba.com, returning a tidy player directory.

file:R/nbagl_schedule.R.name: nbagl_schedule.R
file:R/nbagl_schedule.R.summary: Retrieves the NBA G-League schedule (nbagl_schedule) from the data.nba.com schedule feed, returning a tidy season schedule with game dates and matchups.

file:R/nbagl_standings.R.name: nbagl_standings.R
file:R/nbagl_standings.R.summary: Retrieves current NBA G-League standings (nbagl_standings) via the NBA Stats standings feed on s.data.nba.com, returning a tidy team standings table.

file:R/ncaa_mbb_data.R.name: ncaa_mbb_data.R
file:R/ncaa_mbb_data.R.summary: Scrapes NCAA.com / stats.ncaa.org for men's college basketball NET rankings (ncaa_mbb_NET_rankings) and the Division I/II/III team directory (ncaa_mbb_teams) by year and division.

file:R/realgm_draft.R.name: realgm_draft.R
file:R/realgm_draft.R.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com draft pages for historical draft results (realgm_draft) and early-entry candidate lists (realgm_early_entry), returning tidy draft data frames.

file:R/realgm_players.R.name: realgm_players.R
file:R/realgm_players.R.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com player pages for the player directory (realgm_players), players abroad (realgm_players_abroad), and future free agents (realgm_future_free_agents).

file:R/realgm_salaries.R.name: realgm_salaries.R
file:R/realgm_salaries.R.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com salary-cap pages for the league salary cap history (realgm_salary_cap) and the rookie scale tables (realgm_rookie_scale).

file:R/realgm_staff.R.name: realgm_staff.R
file:R/realgm_staff.R.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com staff pages for coaching staff (realgm_coaches) and general manager (realgm_gms) directories, returning tidy personnel tables.

file:R/realgm_standings.R.name: realgm_standings.R
file:R/realgm_standings.R.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com for league standings (realgm_standings) and the team directory (realgm_teams), returning tidy standings and team-lookup data frames.

file:R/realgm_stats.R.name: realgm_stats.R
file:R/realgm_stats.R.summary: Largest RealGM scraper: pulls player and team season stats, individual season/game logs, and draft-prospect stats (realgm_player_stats, realgm_team_stats, realgm_individual_seasons, realgm_individual_games, realgm_draft_prospects) from basketball.realgm.com.

file:R/realgm_transactions.R.name: realgm_transactions.R
file:R/realgm_transactions.R.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com transaction pages via rvest (realgm_transactions), returning a tidy table of player signings, trades, and roster moves.

file:R/realgm_utils.R.name: realgm_utils.R
file:R/realgm_utils.R.summary: Shared internal helpers for the RealGM scrapers, providing chromote-driven page rendering, URL building, and rvest/janitor table-cleaning utilities consumed across the realgm_* modules.

file:R/rotowire_injuries.R.name: rotowire_injuries.R
file:R/rotowire_injuries.R.summary: Exports rotowire_injuries(), which pulls the current NBA injury report from RotoWire's public JSON feed and returns a tidy tibble of player injury statuses.

file:R/salary_draft_utils.R.name: salary_draft_utils.R
file:R/salary_draft_utils.R.summary: Internal shared HTML-scraping helpers (ext_html, parse_currency, next_data) used by the HoopsHype salaries, Spotrac team-cap, and NBADraft.net mock-draft wrappers; all sources are public HTML requiring no API key.

file:R/spotrac_team_cap.R.name: spotrac_team_cap.R
file:R/spotrac_team_cap.R.summary: Exports spotrac_team_cap(), scraping Spotrac's public team salary-cap pages into a tibble of per-team cap and contract figures.

file:R/torvik_game_schedule.R.name: torvik_game_schedule.R
file:R/torvik_game_schedule.R.summary: Exports torvik_game_schedule(), retrieving Bart Torvik's men's college basketball game schedule data as a tidy tibble.

file:R/torvik_game_stats.R.name: torvik_game_stats.R
file:R/torvik_game_stats.R.summary: Exports torvik_game_stats(), fetching per-game advanced statistics from barttorvik.com for men's college basketball games.

file:R/torvik_ncaa_results.R.name: torvik_ncaa_results.R
file:R/torvik_ncaa_results.R.summary: Exports torvik_ncaa_results(), scraping Bart Torvik's historical NCAA tournament results tables into a tidy tibble.

file:R/torvik_player_stats.R.name: torvik_player_stats.R
file:R/torvik_player_stats.R.summary: Exports torvik_player_stats(), pulling Bart Torvik player-level season statistics for men's college basketball.

file:R/torvik_ratings.R.name: torvik_ratings.R
file:R/torvik_ratings.R.summary: Exports torvik_ratings(), retrieving Bart Torvik's team efficiency ratings for men's college basketball as a tibble.

file:R/torvik_team_factors.R.name: torvik_team_factors.R
file:R/torvik_team_factors.R.summary: Exports torvik_team_factors(), fetching Bart Torvik four-factors and tempo-free team metrics for men's college basketball.

file:R/torvik_utils.R.name: torvik_utils.R
file:R/torvik_utils.R.summary: Internal shared HTTP layer (torvik_text) for the family of torvik_*() scrapers, centralizing requests to barttorvik.com which needs no account or API key.

file:R/utils_nba_stats.R.name: utils_nba_stats.R
file:R/utils_nba_stats.R.summary: Internal HTTP and result-parsing layer for the NBA Stats / G-League APIs: builds endpoint requests (with proxy support), maps stats.nba.com resultSets into tibbles, and provides id/time padding plus schedule-rejoin helpers.

file:R/utils.R.name: utils.R
file:R/utils.R.summary: Package-wide utility module: KenPom login/credential handling, cached CSV/RDS loaders from URLs, season/year helpers (most_recent_mbb_season, year_to_season), team-name normalization, progress messaging, and the hoopR_data S3 class with its print method.

file:README.Rmd.name: README.Rmd
file:README.Rmd.summary: Source R Markdown for the package README rendered to README.md, covering hoopR's purpose, installation, quick-start usage, and documentation links.

file:vignettes/cbbd-college-basketball-d.name: cbbd-college-basketball-data.Rmd
file:vignettes/cbbd-college-basketball-d.summary: Vignette documenting the CollegeBasketballData (CBD/CBBD) endpoints in hoopR, including API-key registration and worked examples for conferences, teams, venues, and other reference data.

file:vignettes/espn-endpoints.Rmd.name: espn-endpoints.Rmd
file:vignettes/espn-endpoints.Rmd.summary: Comprehensive vignette walking through hoopR's ESPN NBA and MBB endpoint surface, organized by use case with worked examples (news, scores, schedules, rosters, and more).

file:vignettes/getting-started-hoopR.Rmd.name: getting-started-hoopR.Rmd
file:vignettes/getting-started-hoopR.Rmd.summary: Getting-started vignette covering hoopR installation, a quick-start example, and credits to authors and contributors.

file:vignettes/kenpom-example-functions..name: kenpom-example-functions.Rmd
file:vignettes/kenpom-example-functions..summary: Vignette demonstrating the KenPom (kp_*) ratings, team, and historical table functions in hoopR with example calls.

file:vignettes/mbb-cookbook.Rmd.name: mbb-cookbook.Rmd
file:vignettes/mbb-cookbook.Rmd.summary: Recipe-style men's college basketball cookbook vignette stitching together hoopR loaders (schedule, PBP, KenPom tempo-free metrics) into end-to-end analysis workflows.

file:vignettes/nba-cookbook.Rmd.name: nba-cookbook.Rmd
file:vignettes/nba-cookbook.Rmd.summary: Recipe-style NBA cookbook vignette showing how to combine hoopR's ESPN and NBA Stats loaders at different levels of detail (game summary, box scores, play-by-play) into worked analysis examples.
